## 16:41Z - OpenCode Go is the only production inference upstream

- **Task:** Disable OpenRouter in the generation, revision, SEO, and Worker AI
  paths and use only OpenCode Go. Work OS ledger `17b43745-ee8d-47d9-aa8e-d47f8c1b65c3`.
- **Branch/worktree:** `codex/launchloom-opencode-go-only` at
  `/home/maigreeks/projects/.worktrees/launchloom-opencode-go-only`.
- **Intended outcome:** Production workflows and code default to
  `opencode-go`; selecting `openrouter` fails closed. The legacy transport
  remains in the repository for the manual evaluation labs and test coverage,
  but no production path can reach it.

### Changes

- `scripts/creative-lane-inference.mjs` and `scripts/generate-site-config.mjs`
  default to `opencode-go` and reject `openrouter` outside test mode. Tests
  keep a `VITEST`-only legacy transport fallback.
- `scripts/revision-engine.mjs` and `scripts/human-revision-gate.mjs` now issue
  revision planning and acceptance audits through the Go Responses transport.
- `scripts/seo-intent-planner.mjs` adds `createOpenCodeGoIntentQueryPlanner`;
  `scripts/seo-research.mjs` uses it and no longer starts the OpenRouter web
  search fallback. Measured SEO stays on DataForSEO plus deterministic queries.
- `scripts/generate-contextual-assets.mjs` checks the Go review key before
  spending a FAL request and reports `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY-not-configured`.
- `scripts/verify-client-pipeline-fixtures.mjs` and the two creative canary
  scripts now require the Go key and mock or select the Go transport.
- `worker/src/opencode-go.ts` adds the Worker Responses boundary for intake
  service suggestions and the visitor AI assistant. Both endpoints now require
  `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`.
- `generate-client.yml`, `test-generation.yml`, `process-feedback.yml`,
  `process-client-feedback.yml`, `repair-creative-candidate.yml`, and
  `deploy-platform.yml` pin both selectors to `opencode-go` and require/push
  `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`. The per-dispatch `inference_provider` lever is
  removed.
